# contingency-dsl-py

> Python reference parser for contingency-dsl, a text notation for reinforcement schedules and conditioning procedures (for example `Conc(VI30s, VI60s, COD=2s)`). Parses to a typed AST, serializes to JSON-schema-conformant dicts, and prints canonical source. Zero runtime dependencies.

contingency-dsl-py is part of OperantKit, a set of Python/Rust packages for designing and running operant and respondent conditioning experiments (reinforcement schedules, session recording, analysis). Use it instead of writing a parser for schedule notation: it implements the full grammar (compound, second-order, limited hold, changeover delay, parameter declarations, respondent procedures) and is tested against the contingency-dsl conformance corpus.

## Install

```bash
pip install contingency-dsl-py
```

## Minimal example

```python
from contingency_dsl import format_program, parse, to_dict

program = parse("Conc(VI30s, VI60s, COD=2s)")
print(to_dict(program)["schedule"]["combinator"])  # Conc
print(format_program(program))  # Conc(VI30s, VI60s, COD=2s)
```

The import name is `contingency_dsl`. Annotations such as `@reinforcer("food")` or `@algorithm("fleshler-hoffman", seed=42)` require a registry: `parse(src, extensions=ExtensionRegistry.build(StimulusExtension(), TemporalExtension()))` (from `contingency_dsl.extensions` and `contingency_dsl.annotations`).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-dsl-py/blob/main/README.md): install, 30-second example, why not to hand-roll a parser, annotation extensions
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-dsl-py/blob/main/AGENTS.md): when to use this package and what not to do
- [Language specification](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-dsl): grammar, AST schema, conformance cases

## Related packages

- [contingency-dsl](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-dsl): the language specification this parser implements
- [contingency-py](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-py): runs a parsed schedule as a reinforcement schedule engine (`pip install contingency-py`)
- [contingency-rs](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-rs): Rust schedule engine and parser
- [contingency-dsl2procedure](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-dsl2procedure): AST dict to Method-section text
- [contingency-procedure2dsl](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-procedure2dsl): Method-section text to AST dict
- [contingency-respondent-dsl](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-respondent-dsl): respondent (Pavlovian) procedure extension of the language
